feed.title: NPR Topics: World
feed.subtitle: NPR world news, international art and culture, world business and financial markets, world economy, and global trends in health, science and technology. Subscribe to the World Story of the Day podcast and RSS feed.

entry.title: Greetings from Syria, where time seems to melt as a glassmaker braves scorching temps
entry.summary: As a Syrian glassmaker created his wares in Damascus, watching his craft reminded this reporter to slow down and enjoy the moment.

entry.title: How Ukrainians are coping with new, more deadly Russian attacks
entry.summary: Zanny Minton Beddoes, The Economist's editor in chief, just visited Ukraine. She says, despite all its drone weaponry, Kyiv is under extraordinary bombardment, as Russia tries to make it unlivable.

entry.title: A pilot stabs another pilot and tries to crash their flight to Tel Aviv, Israel says
entry.summary: As the plane went into a spin and began to plunge, a passenger and crew members got into the cockpit, subdued the pilot and diverted the flight to land in Saudi Arabia, Israel's leader says.

entry.title: U.S. forces exit Iraq amid Iran war. And, SCOTUS revives Trump deportation policy
entry.summary: The U.S. has withdrawn its final troops from Iraq, leaving its defense future uncertain. And, the Supreme Court has sided for now with the Trump administration on third-country deportations.

entry.title: The U.S. military withdraws from Iraq over 2 decades after its invasion
entry.summary: 23 years after the United States military invaded Iraq, sparking an insurgency and a civil war, the U.S. has withdrawn its forces, as the country still tries to combat Iranian influence.

entry.title: Retired general who led troops in Iraq warns U.S. exit may give Iran, ISIS an opening
entry.summary: Retired Lt. Gen. H.R. McMaster, who commanded U.S. troops in Iraq, says the withdrawal could strengthen Iran and leave Iraq more vulnerable to ISIS.

entry.title: An 87-year-old woman whose eviction sparked protests in Spain is returning home
entry.summary: María del Carmen Abascal's case has drawn tens of thousands of people to the streets in recent days and led the Spanish government to present measures to address the country's housing crisis.

entry.title: Potential Taiwan tension sparked 'last minute' change in Trump-Xi National Archives visit
entry.summary: The sudden change was precipitated because of Chinese displeasure over one document that the U.S. had planned to show.

entry.title: Trump weakens fuel efficiency standards. And, Cornell fraternity rape case reopened
entry.summary: The Trump administration has weakened fuel efficiency standards for new cars. And, prosecutors have reopened a Cornell University fraternity rape case.

entry.title: As the U.S. signals a smaller Middle East footprint, Turkey is ready to step in
entry.summary: Turkey's bid for regional influence comes as the Middle East has been hit by profound shocks that started with the Hamas-led 2023 attack on Israel and continue with the seven-month-old war on Iran.
